note: The canvas's guides and gridlines. Gridlines: every 12 points over the slide, under its objects, while View > Gridlines is on. Guides: with View > Guides on, the canvas draws the deck's guides, or the slide's centre lines when it has none; objects snap to them as they move, as they do to the grid. A guide dragged out of a ruler turns the guides on (viewChanged).

computed.guidesShown: {{!state.guides ? { vertical: [], horizontal: [] } : length(state.board.guides.vertical ?? []) + length(state.board.guides.horizontal ?? []) > 0 ? state.board.guides : computed.centreGuides}}

gridLines.note: The gridlines over the slide, under its objects, while View > Gridlines is on.
